Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Manoj - 30 years, prince, son
Look: turban, blue angarkha, a sash
2. Meenakshi - 57 years, queen, mother
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
3. Sanjay - 26 years, friend
Look: moustache, checked shirt
4. Shalini - 32 years, princess, daughter
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress
5. Neeta - 33 years, friend
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The battlefield - tents, flags, dust

Scene 1: The battlefield - Day

[Manoj stands on the battlefield. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Manoj: "What lovely weather!"

[A sword slashes Manoj's arm and blood runs down to his wrist.]

Manoj: "Oh wow!"

[Wounded, Manoj staggers and drops to one knee.]

Manoj: "That's easy."

[Manoj breathes his last as Mother holds his hand.]

Meenakshi: "Rest in peace."
